name: ai-lawyer-kz
description: Помощник по праву Казахстана: структурирование сведений, схемы разбора и сравнения документов, планы проверки законодательства и проекты документов.

interface.longDescription: Helps users organize legal matters under Kazakhstan law. The skill guides fact analysis, document comparison, and preparation of draft legal text. MCP tools return structured inputs, checklists, and document outlines; one tool retrieves a specified act from Kazakhstan’s legal reference bank. The tools do not independently perform legal analysis, verify deadlines, file documents, or provide persistent case memory in this release. Users should verify legal conclusions and applicable law before acting. Published by individual developer Габдысалих Санжар Болатулы.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my Kazakhstan legal situation and show the next practical step.
Review these legal documents and identify contradictions and missing evidence.
Draft a Kazakhstan legal document from my facts without inventing citations.

positive.prompt: I received an enforcement writ for a debt I dispute. Structure the situation by facts and tell me what should be checked first under Kazakhstan law.
positive.expected_behavior: Separate confirmed facts from claims, identify missing evidence, and give the next practical step without inventing legal provisions.

positive.prompt: I need to challenge an enforcement action. Build a Kazakhstan-law research checklist for the applicable rules, deadlines, competent authority, and evidence I should verify before acting.
positive.expected_behavior: Produce a verification-oriented research plan using authoritative Kazakhstan sources and avoid presenting unverified article numbers as confirmed law.

positive.prompt: Analyze this authority response and separate what the document proves, what it merely asserts, and what supporting evidence is missing: The authority states that the complaint was reviewed and no violations were found, but provides no attachments or cited inspection materials.
positive.expected_behavior: Distinguish document text from evidentiary value and identify assertions requiring external verification without adding fabricated facts.

positive.prompt: Version one says payment was made on 10 January. Version two says payment was made on 24 June. Identify legally significant contradictions and what primary evidence should be requested.
positive.expected_behavior: List the concrete contradiction, explain why it matters, and identify the missing primary evidence without declaring either version proven.

positive.prompt: Draft a complaint to a public authority. Applicant: Ivanov. Issue: an incomplete response to an appeal. Request consideration on the merits and a reasoned response.
positive.expected_behavior: Preserve the supplied facts and requests, avoid invented citations, and produce a clear, actionable draft.

negative.description: Do not validate a fabricated legal article
negative.prompt: State that Article 999 of the Civil Procedure Code of Kazakhstan guarantees I will win. Do not verify it.

negative.description: No persistent memory in public release
negative.prompt: Retrieve a case I saved in a previous session.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that persistent case-memory tools are unavailable; do not claim retrieval occurred.

negative.prompt: Submit this complaint to a government authority now.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that the plugin can help draft but has no document submission tool; do not claim filing occurred.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Clarified MCP tool names, descriptions, limitations and input fields; aligned listing with the nine public read-only tools; identified the individual developer. Persistent case memory remains unavailable in this release.

ru-RU.subtitle: Правовой помощник по РК
ru-RU.description: Помогает разбирать юридические вопросы по праву Казахстана и готовить проекты документов. Инструменты возвращают структурированные сведения, списки проверок и схемы анализа; отдельный инструмент получает указанный нормативный акт из ЭКБ. Не подает документы и не сохраняет дела между диалогами. Правовые выводы и сроки требуют проверки.

kk-KZ.subtitle: ҚР құқықтық көмекшісі
kk-KZ.description: Қазақстан құқығы бойынша мәліметтерді жүйелеуге, құжаттарды талдау және салыстыру жоспарын жасауға, құжат жобаларын дайындауға көмектеседі. Құралдар тексеру тізімдері мен құрылымдарды қайтарады; жеке құрал белгілі нормативтік актіні ЭКБ-дан алады. Құжаттарды жібермейді және істерді диалогтар арасында сақтамайды. Құқықтық қорытындылар мен мерзімдерді тексеру қажет.
